# proxmox_lxc_interfaces (Data Source)

Lists interfaces of a running container from `/nodes/{node}/lxc/{vmid}/interfaces`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_lxc_interfaces" "i" {
  node = "pve-1"
  vmid = 200
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `interfaces` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `inet` (String)
- `inet6` (String)
- `mac` (String)
- `name` (String)
